task.name: Issue Response SLA Enforcement
task.description: Review newly opened operator-routed issues in covered repositories and surface only issues that have exceeded the repository's first-response service-level target without an already tracked or explicitly accepted exception.
task.intent: Reduce operator time spent discovering unattended operator-routed issues while avoiding duplicate attention on response delays that are already tracked or explicitly accepted.
activationConditions: An issue labeled for operator response is opened or relabeled into the operator-routed queue within the evidence window in a covered repository.
Authoritative repository issue evidence shows the issue has no qualifying maintainer first response before the repository's configured response deadline.
requiredEffects: Each novel response-SLA finding identifies the issue, the operator-routing label or queue membership evidence, the configured response deadline, and the absence of a qualifying maintainer response before that deadline.
Maintainers can accept, reject, or resolve each surfaced finding using repository-linked evidence.
noopConditions: No covered operator-routed issue has exceeded the configured first-response deadline.
Every supported issue-response-SLA finding for the covered overdue issues is already tracked or explicitly accepted.
successConditions: Supported issue-response-SLA findings receive accepted remediation evidence or an explicit maintainer dismissal within 7 days of the workflow run.
Issues that received a qualifying maintainer first response before the deadline create no duplicate maintainer attention.
uncertainties: A repository may define a qualifying first response narrowly, for example requiring a human maintainer comment rather than an automated acknowledgment.
A documented exception may intentionally pause the response clock for one issue during a known incident or scheduled freeze while still requiring explicit acceptance evidence.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported, novel issue-response-SLA findings assigned to the run that are resolved or explicitly dismissed within 7 days.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated supported issue-response-SLA findings it assigns for overdue covered operator-routed issues.
acceptedEvidence: A maintainer comment, issue timeline event, or linked repository record showing the identified issue received a qualifying first response after the finding and before the evidence cutoff.
A closed tracking issue, issue conversation, or repository-linked exception record that explicitly marks the issue-response-SLA finding resolved, dismissed, or accepted by a maintainer.
evidenceRepositories: The repository in which the workflow ran.

metric.name: resolved-supported-issue-response-sla-findings
metric.formula: resolved-or-dismissed supported issue-response-SLA findings / supported novel issue-response-SLA findings assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: 7 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported novel issue-response-SLA finding was assigned and none has accepted resolution evidence by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned issue-response-SLA finding set or required repository issue and timeline evidence for overdue covered operator-routed issues cannot be read.
